correctness.rationale: For positive dampings and switch rates a,b,c,d,p,q and independent positive diffusivities, the stationary OU convolution exists uniquely. Conditioned on the complete shared environment, X1,X2 are independent centered Gaussians; Cov(X1,X2)=0 and their mixed fourth cumulant equals Cov(V1,V2) of conditional variances. Generator equations for state-weighted first moments U,T and product moment Z are exact invertible 2x2 systems with determinants K1,K2,K12>0. Algebraic elimination yields numerator p*q*(a-b)*(c-d)*N, N a sum of strictly positive parameter monomials, proving the necessary-and-sufficient sign/zero classification. Independently derived the full expression by symbolic 2x2 inversions and factored Cov(V1,V2) into precisely 4D1D2pq(a-b)(c-d)N/[(p+q)^2 K1 K2 K12], for unconstrained symbolic positive parameters; no reliance on finite samples. The sign vanishes exactly when a=b or c=d.
